results.expected: with the fixture enhancer selected and no residential route: a 403 and a 200 challenge go direct_http then enhanced, and a script shell whose render is a challenge goes direct_http, direct_browser, then enhanced in browser mode, each returning the target's page as the provider fetched it with proxyUsed stealth and one provider request; route enhanced goes to the provider alone; with the fixture proxy too, a challenge goes direct_http, residential_http, enhanced and the script shell uses all four attempts (direct_http, direct_browser, residential_browser, enhanced); a stealth request stops at the residential route and never reaches the provider; the targets saw each route's request

results.name: four-attempts-one-enhanced-no-paid-retry-multiplication
results.expected: across the fixture phase: no acquisition uses more than four attempts or more than one enhanced strategy; every provider request the fixture received is one logged enhanced dispatch (as many requests as dispatch lines, none repeated for a page); a page challenged by the provider too gets exactly one request and a typed failure; every enhanced ledger row is one per logical page, and a charged one (a 200) settled at the card's highest-tier price for its mode (1270 or 16080 micro-USD) while the free failures were released
results.actual: failed=none; acquisitions=71, max attempts=4, dispatch lines=17, provider requests=17; ledger rows=32 (settled 13, released 18, uncertain 1)

results.name: target-and-provider-errors-apart
results.expected: a target's own outcome through the provider is judged as the target's: its 404 is the page with status 404, its 401 is AUTH_REQUIRED, its 429 is RATE_LIMITED and cools the domain on every route (a later basic request is refused with no target request), and an answer ending at a Cloud host is CLOUD_DENIED; the provider's own failures are its own: a ban (520) is BLOCKED_PUBLIC_CONTENT and released free, a request with no answer is ENHANCED_UNCERTAIN and stays reserved, a rate limit (429) and a refused key (401) are PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED and PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED and released free, each after one request; none of them changes the domain's routing record
results.actual: failed=none; 404→404, 401→AUTH_REQUIRED, 429→RATE_LIMITED (cooldown 30 s), cloud→CLOUD_DENIED; provider 520→BLOCKED_PUBLIC_CONTENT RELEASED, silent→ENHANCED_UNCERTAIN UNCERTAIN, 429→PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED, 401→PROVIDER_AUTH_FAILED; m7esc route={"preferred":null,"challenges":0,"failures":1,"last_failure_class":"BLOCKED_PUBLIC_CONTENT"}

results.name: outage-and-exhausted-budget-without-cloud
results.expected: with the production selection (Zyte, paid dispatch off, whether its key is present or absent) a request for the enhanced tier is ENHANCED_REQUIRED and an auto challenge BLOCKED_PUBLIC_CONTENT naming both unavailable tiers, with no provider request and no attempt beyond the direct one, while an ordinary page is fetched directly; with the small fixture category full (concurrent reservations granted exactly the room left) the next dispatch is refused as ENHANCED_REQUIRED (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) before any request; after three counted provider failures the breaker is open, the tier is refused with no request, and direct scrapes and MCP scrapes go on (AC23)
results.actual: failed=none; production ENHANCED_REQUIRED/BLOCKED_PUBLIC_CONTENT; race granted 15 of 15 expected (cap 20000, used 0); exhausted ENHANCED_REQUIRED; breaker open; direct 200, mcp 200

results.name: live-enhanced-request
